items.lede: A new GitHub repository dubbed ram-altman features a script to monitor your PC’s RAM usage and report back to the eponymous OpenAI boss.
items.title: Spoof program monitors and emails your RAM usage to Sam Altman if under 90% utilization

items.lede: We verified the RAM numbers are real without sending any emails to OpenAI.
items.title: A Sam Altman parody offers an amusing lesson in memory management
